Package edu.cnu.mdi.item

Class TextItem

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.item.AItem
edu.cnu.mdi.item.PathBasedItem
edu.cnu.mdi.item.PolygonItem
edu.cnu.mdi.item.RectangleItem
edu.cnu.mdi.item.TextItem
All Implemented Interfaces:
IFeedbackProvider, IDrawable, ITextEditable, EventListener
public class TextItem extends RectangleItem implements ITextEditable
A drawable item that renders text with a rectangular background/border.

Key invariants:

  • AItem._focus is the world-coordinate center of the text box.
  • Path corners are computed via a screen-space round-trip: world focus → screen focus → pixel corners → world corners. This is required because font metrics are in pixels and the world coordinate system may have an entirely different scale.
  • Rotation is handled in screen space. A world-space affine rotation only looks correct when scaleX == scaleY (square world units). With a non-square world (e.g. world=(0,0,1,1) on a non-square window) a world-space rotation shears the rectangle so it no longer matches the text drawn by TextUtils.drawRotatedText(java.awt.Graphics2D, java.awt.Point, java.lang.String, java.awt.Font, java.awt.Color, double, int), which rotates in screen space. The fix: rotate the four screen corners, then convert to world.

    • modify

      public void modify()
      Override ROTATE so the bounding-box path is rebuilt via a screen-space rotation rather than a world-space affine rotation.

      A world-space rotation is only correct when scaleX == scaleY. With a non-square world coordinate system the inherited world-space rotation shears the rectangle out of alignment with the text drawn by TextUtils.drawRotatedText(java.awt.Graphics2D, java.awt.Point, java.lang.String, java.awt.Font, java.awt.Color, double, int) (which rotates in screen space). By computing the new path corners in screen space we guarantee that the outline exactly matches the text at every azimuth.

      DRAG and RESIZE fall through to PathBasedItem.modify(), which operates correctly in world space for those two operations.

      Overrides:
      modify in class PathBasedItem

    • getRotatedPoints

      public Point2D.Double[] getRotatedPoints(double azimuthDegrees)
      Four rotated world corners. Rotation is done in screen space (CW for positive degrees, matching TextUtils.drawRotatedText(java.awt.Graphics2D, java.awt.Point, java.lang.String, java.awt.Font, java.awt.Color, double, int)) and the result is converted back to world coordinates.
      Parameters:
      azimuthDegrees - screen-space CW angle in degrees

    • getText

      public String getText()
      Description copied from interface: ITextEditable
      Returns the current text content.

      Multi-line text is represented with embedded '\n' characters. Implementations must never return null; an empty string is the correct representation of no content.
